_views.text: Synthesis_System is the oscillator engine. Each sprite has its own oscillator tuned to a base frequency: Aether at 639 Hz (sine), Lumina at 528 Hz (triangle), Solaris at 741 Hz (sine). As sprites orbit, their pan position is calculated from their orbital angle via sin(angle) — Aether at 90° sounds in the right ear, at 270° in the left ear. Crystal state shifts the master frequency: Resonant=639, Divergent=741, Convergent=528, Instable=417. These are the Solfège healing frequencies. CanSynthesize checks that AudioContext is available. The spatial encoding means a non-visual user can track each sprite by ear as they rotate around the Nucleus.
